Although this leak was not external, we’ve locked your account to protect you. You’ll need to reset your password to log in and send money.

  4. Click the link

  5. Choose a new password

 

We apologize for the inconvenience.

content.html:
Dear Customer,

During routine maintenance on our website yesterday evening, we discovered that your password may have been inadvertently exposed to our internal systems.

Although this leak was not external, we’ve locked your account to protect you. You’ll need to reset your password to log in and send money.

 

Luckily, resetting your password is straightforward. You’ll just need to:


 

  1. Enter your email address when prompted to “Reset Password” on the login screen

  2. Click Submit

  3. Go to your email inbox and find the email that was sent

  4. Click the link

  5. Choose a new password

 

 

We apologize for the inconvenience.

Sincerely,
The Ria Money Transfer Team

For more information regarding this BRH policy, visit their website here: https://www.brh.ht/wp-content/uploads/Argumentaires_Circulaire-114-2.pdf

 

Sincerely,

The Ria Money Transfer Team

content.subject: Important message for those sending to Bangladesh
content.preview: 96 Hi there, We recently identified a technical issue affecting customers sending to Bangladesh. To make sure you can still transfer money to Bangladesh, we need you to make a quick change to your account. We need you to delete and re-add y
content.html:
Hi there,

We recently identified a technical issue affecting customers sending to Bangladesh. To make sure you can still transfer money to Bangladesh, we need you to make a quick change to your account. We need you to delete and re-add your recipients to make sure your future transfers are successful.
 
Here’s how: 
 
1. Log in to your Ria account. 
2. Go to Recipients. 
3. Delete your Bangladesh recipient. On our app, you’ll need select the recipient then choose Delete. 
4. Add the recipient again. You can also add them later while sending money! 
 
After that, you’ll be able to send to Bangladesh without any issues.

 

We're sorry for the inconvenience. As an apology, we wanted to offer you this $0 fee promo code for your next transfer to Bangladesh: RIABD
 
Sincerely, 
The Ria Money Transfer Team

Dear {{firstName}},

We wanted to give you a warning about some important changes to our service. Due to Brexit, we’re moving off our UK money transfer licence and will start operating with our Lithuanian licence. This will happen by 31 December 2020.

While this won’t affect how you send with Ria, it does mean you’ll be asked to review and accept our new Terms & Conditions and Privacy Policy before your next transfer. You’ll be able to do this on the Ria Money Transfer app!

Because of the licence change, you'll also need to update your ID on file. Unfortunately, we are no longer able to accept driver's licences as valid forms of ID. Instead, you can use a passport, residence permit or national identity card.

For more information on this licence migration, explore our FAQs. If you have any questions, don’t hesitate to contact our Customer Service team.

Viskas kas geriausia, or, all the best (we’re practising our Lithuanian),

The Ria Money Transfer Team
